baseline.load_method: previous_week_same_slot_base_load; past interval must have ended by issued_at
baseline.pv_method: previous_day_same_slot_trapezoid_interval_average; past interval must have ended by issued_at
baseline.load_interval_heuristic_kw: point ± (100 + 0.1 × point), clipped at zero; no coverage claim
baseline.pv_interval_heuristic_kw: point ± (100 + 0.25 × point), clipped to [0,5000]; no coverage claim
baseline.validity: Only selected 4×15min offline replay windows; no published model or live weather feed

scenario_assumptions.selection: Post hoc deterministic stress-window selection from synthetic truth; not a blind test or predictive feature
scenario_assumptions.booking_rule: For each scenario, take three distinct-port sessions whose entire service ended before as_of from the previous seven days, using a deterministic shuffle seeded by seed+date ordinal. Use only their past requested_energy_kwh as templates; generate new BOOK-scenario IDs. Bookings occur 60min before as_of and become available 30min before as_of. The third is cancelled 5min before as_of. This independent synthetic event process is for interface tests only; it does not reveal future historical sessions.
scenario_assumptions.arrival_rule: Synthetic booked vehicles generate arrival events at as_of+15min, hence are not visible at as_of. Original future session IDs, actual end_at and charging power never enter events.
scenario_assumptions.request_rule: Independent hypothetical requests at as_of; each requests 50kWh, max 240kW, assigned distinct ports not already booked. They do not overwrite historical sessions.
scenario_assumptions.tariff_basis: Synthetic illustrative time-of-use import price, no claimed utility tariff; fixed for 2025, no export revenue
scenario_assumptions.storage_state_basis: Synthetic at-window initial state; original package only supplies 2025-01-01 initial state, so no later state is inferred from its partial trajectory

splits.warning: Pre-existing models and scenario selection have seen 2025 data; replay_evaluation is chronological bookkeeping, not an untouched blind test
